summary: The cognitive component is the engine's memory and reflection substrate for the learn stage. It runs a 4-tier HierarchicalMemory (Working, ShortTerm, LongTerm, Archive), records Episodes with outcomes, indexes the codebase as a knowledge graph of Entities and RelationTypes, maintains a SelfModel with introspection and modification tracking, ranks improvement strategies via a MetaLearner, retrieves code context through RAG, and dynamically splits the token budget by TaskType. On the loop it closes the cycle: it captures what happened, promotes what mattered, introspects the agent's own state, and feeds a grounded LlmContext back into the next perceive/reason pass.
context_basis: Recommendations were formed with src/cognitive/ read in the context of the full engine under a ~600k budget framing; token-budget task-type splits and memory-tier capacities assume a large context that must be actively partitioned across working/episodic/semantic recall.

examples.title: Retrieve the top relevant Episodes for the current query
examples.intent: Bring past experiences that match the query into working context before reasoning.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: EpisodicMemory.retrieve_relevant ranks Episodes by relevance and Importance, injecting top-k into the LlmContext so the perceive stage arrives pre-loaded with prior outcomes.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Spreading over the memory node fans out matching episode cards ranked by importance closest to the center.
touch_interaction.visual: Episode cards bloom outward; high-importance ones glow gold and pull inward, low ones fade to the edges.

examples.mini_scenario: The user spreads the episodic node on a debugging query and the three highest-importance error episodes bloom in, seeding the context.
examples.pitfall: Retrieval must respect the importance threshold; flooding context with low-importance episodes crowds out the semantic code the reasoning actually needs.

examples.title: Record an Episode with its outcome after acting
examples.intent: Persist what just happened, its outcome, and any lessons for future recall.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: After the act stage, an Episode (type, content, outcome, insights) is written and linked to related_episodes, giving the learn stage a durable trace to promote and mine.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Tapping the learn node stamps a new episode tile onto the memory timeline at the current cycle.
touch_interaction.visual: A fresh tile drops in with a green check (Success) or red cross (Error) badge and a pulsing 'new' glow that fades.

examples.mini_scenario: A tool run fixes a failing test; a Success episode is stamped with the lesson 'checked lock ordering', linked to the prior Error episode.
examples.pitfall: Record the true outcome, not the intended one; logging a Success on an unverified action poisons future relevance recall with false confidence.

examples.title: Promote a ShortTerm memory to LongTerm on repeated access
examples.intent: Move memories that keep proving useful into durable storage.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: HierarchicalMemory promotes a MemoryEntry from ShortTerm to LongTerm when access_count and importance cross thresholds, reshaping what survives across sessions.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Dragging a memory tile upward across the tier boundary promotes it; the boundary flexes and accepts it if thresholds are met.
touch_interaction.visual: The tile brightens as it crosses; the LongTerm band ripples and locks it in with a subtle anchor icon.

examples.mini_scenario: A pattern recalled five times this session drags up past the promotion threshold into LongTerm, so it persists into tomorrow's run.
examples.pitfall: Promotion must be gated by both access and importance; promoting on access alone lets high-frequency noise clog LongTerm.

examples.title: Split the token budget by detected TaskType
examples.intent: Allocate the context window to working/episodic/semantic recall according to what the task needs.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: TokenBudgetAllocator maps the detected TaskType to a TokenBudget split (e.g. SelfImprovement 10/10/70), so the control layer partitions the window before context assembly.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Rotating the budget wheel redistributes its three colored arcs (working/episodic/semantic) to the task-type preset.
touch_interaction.visual: The pie wheel spins to the preset split; the semantic arc swells green for a self-improvement task, the arcs snapping into place.

examples.mini_scenario: The allocator detects a self-improvement query and rotates the budget to 70% semantic, giving the agent room to read its own code.
examples.pitfall: Always keep the response_reserve; a split that consumes 100% of the window on recall leaves no room to generate an answer.

examples.title: Assemble a single LlmContext from all memory sources
examples.intent: Fuse working, episodic, semantic, and self-context into one prompt within budget.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: CognitiveSystem.build_context merges WorkingContext, retrieved Episodes, CodeContext, and self-improvement context into an LlmContext with an estimated token count the loop can gate on.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Pinching the four source nodes together fuses them into one context tile stamped with its estimated tokens.
touch_interaction.visual: Four streams braid into a single glowing tile; a token meter fills along its edge, green under budget, amber near the limit.

examples.mini_scenario: The user pinches working, episodic, semantic, and self nodes into one LlmContext reading 340k estimated tokens, ready to send.
examples.pitfall: The estimate must reflect the actual assembled content; a stale estimate lets an over-budget context reach the model and truncate silently.

examples.title: Introspect the agent's current state on demand
examples.intent: Answer 'what is my state / what can I do' from the self-reference system rather than guessing.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: IntrospectionEngine resolves an IntrospectionTarget (CurrentState, Capabilities, Memory, Performance, Decisions) against ReferenceState, feeding the reason stage grounded facts about itself.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Double-tapping the self node opens a mirror panel listing the chosen introspection target's answer.
touch_interaction.visual: A reflective mirror-surface node flips open; the target's facts scroll up in a cool blue introspection panel.

examples.mini_scenario: Before proposing a change, the agent double-taps to introspect Capabilities and confirms it has the tool-dispatch ability the plan needs.
examples.pitfall: Introspection answers reflect the recorded SelfModel; if recent CodeModifications were not applied to the model, the agent introspects a stale self.

examples.title: Climb reference levels from Direct to Reflective
examples.intent: Reason about the agent's own reasoning at increasing depth.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: ReferenceState tracks current_level (Direct, Meta, MetaMeta, Reflective); ascending a level reframes the reason stage from 'what' to 'why I decided that way'.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Spreading vertically on the self node steps it up a reference level, nesting a new reflective frame around the current one.
touch_interaction.visual: Concentric rings nest outward, each labeled Direct, Meta, MetaMeta, Reflective, the active ring pulsing.

examples.mini_scenario: After a failed plan the agent spreads to Meta level to ask why it preferred the failing strategy, then adjusts its priors.
examples.pitfall: Deeper is not always better; ascending to Reflective on every trivial query burns budget on navel-gazing instead of acting.

examples.title: Rank improvement strategies with the MetaLearner
examples.intent: Choose which kind of self-improvement to attempt next based on what has worked.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: MetaLearner tracks a StrategyScore per category (PromptTemplate, ToolPipeline, ErrorHandling...) via EMA of effectiveness, biasing the reason stage toward historically successful categories.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Flicking the strategy panel reorders category bars by their current effectiveness score.
touch_interaction.visual: Horizontal bars re-sort with a smooth slide; the top category glows green, a cooling-down one greys with a clock icon.

examples.mini_scenario: ErrorHandling has the highest EMA this week, so the MetaLearner ranks it first and the agent picks an error-recovery improvement.
examples.pitfall: Respect the cooldown; re-picking a category that just failed before its cooldown expires ignores the very signal the MetaLearner recorded.

examples.title: Index a new Entity into the knowledge graph
examples.intent: Add a code symbol to the queryable graph so cross-file references resolve.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: A new Entity (Function, Struct, Trait...) is inserted with its RelationTypes (Calls, Uses, Implements), extending the graph the perceive stage queries to ground reasoning in real code.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Dragging a new symbol onto the graph canvas snaps it into place and auto-draws its relation edges.
touch_interaction.visual: The entity node lands and edges fan out to callers and callees, each edge labeled by its RelationType.

examples.mini_scenario: A newly written function is dragged into the graph; Calls edges auto-connect it to its callees so future queries traverse it.
examples.pitfall: Relations must reflect actual code, not naming similarity; inferring an Implements edge from a matching name creates false graph paths.

examples.title: Traverse RelationTypes to answer a cross-file question
examples.intent: Follow Calls/Uses/DependsOn edges to gather the entities a question spans.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: The reason stage walks RelationType edges from a seed Entity to collect a connected subgraph, grounding multi-hop reasoning in real dependencies rather than guesses.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Drawing along an edge from a node walks the graph, lighting each entity reached hop by hop.
touch_interaction.visual: A traveling spark runs the edges; visited nodes light up in sequence and dim behind the spark's trail.

examples.mini_scenario: Asked what breaks if a struct changes, the agent draws out from it along DependsOn edges and lights every dependent module.
examples.pitfall: Bound the traversal depth; an unbounded walk over a densely connected utility entity pulls half the graph into context.

examples.title: Run RAG search to fetch relevant code chunks
examples.intent: Surface the code most relevant to the query within a token budget.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: RAG semantic-searches the indexed codebase, filters by relevance and dedup, and returns a CodeContext the perceive stage folds into the LlmContext.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Long-pressing the RAG node runs a retrieval sweep; matching chunks surface as tiles ranked by score.
touch_interaction.visual: Chunk tiles rise from the node ranked top-down by score; below-threshold chunks stay submerged and greyed.

examples.mini_scenario: On a query about caching, RAG surfaces the three highest-scoring cache chunks and drops a near-duplicate before assembly.
examples.pitfall: Dedup before the budget cut; returning two near-identical chunks wastes budget that a distinct relevant chunk needed.

examples.title: Propose a self-modification with a risk level
examples.intent: Suggest a concrete change to the agent's own code, tagged by risk before review.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: ModificationEngine emits a ProposedModification (modification_type, target, risk_level), so the reason stage hands the act stage a change carrying its own risk gate.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Long-pressing a target module conjures a proposal card with a risk dial the user can read before approving.
touch_interaction.visual: The proposal card floats up with a risk dial (Low green, Critical red); a high-risk dial pulses to demand attention.

examples.mini_scenario: The agent proposes refactoring its context assembler, tagged Medium risk, and the change routes through review before any edit.
examples.pitfall: Risk level must gate execution; treating a Critical proposal like a Low one lets a dangerous self-edit skip the review it warrants.

examples.title: Track a CodeModification against the SelfModel
examples.intent: Keep the agent's self-representation current after it changes its own code.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: An applied CodeModification (file_path, change_type, success) is recorded into the SelfModel's recent_changes, so subsequent introspection reflects the agent's true, evolved self.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Tapping the applied-change badge writes it into the self node's change log, incrementing the version.
touch_interaction.visual: The self node's version chip ticks up; a change entry slides into its log with a Refactor/Addition icon.

examples.mini_scenario: After splitting a module, the CodeModification is tapped into the SelfModel so the next introspection knows the new structure.
examples.pitfall: Record failures too; logging only successful modifications makes the self-model believe every attempt worked.

examples.title: Advance the PDVR cycle phase
examples.intent: Drive the cognitive state machine through Plan, Do, Verify, Reflect.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: CognitiveState.cycle_phase advances through CyclePhase (Plan, Do, Verify, Reflect), giving the control layer an explicit phase that dictates what the loop does next.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Flicking the phase ring rotates it to the next PDVR segment, arming the corresponding stage.
touch_interaction.visual: A four-segment ring rotates; the active segment (Plan/Do/Verify/Reflect) lights, the others dim to grey.

examples.mini_scenario: The Do phase completes, the user flicks the ring to Verify, and the loop dispatches the verification checks.
examples.pitfall: Never skip Verify to reach Reflect; reflecting on an unverified outcome captures lessons from a result that may be wrong.

examples.title: Adapt the budget allocation from observed usage
examples.intent: Correct the token split when real usage drifts from the task-type preset.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: TokenBudgetAllocator.adapt compares usage_history to the budgeted split and shifts future TokenBudget ratios, so the learn stage tunes control-layer allocation over time.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Rotating the budget wheel while a drift overlay is showing nudges the preset toward the observed distribution.
touch_interaction.visual: A ghost overlay shows actual usage; the wheel eases toward it, the arcs settling on a corrected split.

examples.mini_scenario: Debugging tasks kept overspending episodic; adapt nudges the debugging preset to give episodic more of the window next time.
examples.pitfall: Adapt on a stable sample, not one outlier run; a single anomalous session should not rewrite the standing allocation.

examples.title: Link related Episodes to surface a pattern
examples.intent: Connect episodes that share a cause so recurring patterns become visible.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: Setting an Episode's related_episodes stitches experiences into chains the learn stage can mine, turning isolated events into a detectable pattern.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Drawing a line between two episode tiles links them; a shared-cause label appears on the connecting edge.
touch_interaction.visual: A thread ties the tiles; when a third joins the chain, the whole chain flashes to signal a detected pattern.

examples.mini_scenario: Three timeout episodes get linked; the chain flashes and the MetaLearner flags a recurring latency pattern to address.
examples.pitfall: Link by genuine causal relation, not mere co-occurrence; false links invent patterns that mislead the next planning pass.

examples.title: Evict a stale MemoryEntry under capacity pressure
examples.intent: Free tier capacity by demoting or dropping the least valuable memory.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: When a tier hits its MemoryConfig capacity, HierarchicalMemory demotes or evicts the lowest importance/access MemoryEntry, keeping the perceive stage's recall lean.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Flicking a full tier ejects its weakest tile downward toward Archive or off the canvas.
touch_interaction.visual: The tier flashes 'full'; the weakest tile slides down into the Archive band or dissolves at the edge.

examples.mini_scenario: ShortTerm fills up, so the least-accessed entry flicks down to Archive, making room for the current session's memories.
examples.pitfall: Never evict by recency alone; a rarely accessed but Critical-importance entry must survive over frequent trivia.

examples.title: Detect the TaskType from the query up front
examples.intent: Classify the query so budget and recall strategy fit its shape.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: suggest_task_type inspects the query and returns a TaskType (Conversation, CodeAnalysis, SelfImprovement, Debugging...), steering the control layer's budget split and the perceive stage's recall mix.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Tapping the incoming query node classifies it, stamping a TaskType badge that recolors the downstream budget wheel.
touch_interaction.visual: A type badge (e.g. 'Debugging') snaps onto the query; the budget wheel downstream recolors to match the preset.

examples.mini_scenario: The query 'why does this panic' is tapped and classified Debugging, so episodic recall of past errors is boosted.
examples.pitfall: Misclassification cascades; tagging a self-improvement query as Conversation starves the semantic recall it depended on.

examples.title: Extract a Lesson from a verified outcome
examples.intent: Distill a reusable insight from what just succeeded or failed.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: During Reflect, a Lesson is distilled from the Episode outcome and stored, so the learn stage turns a single event into guidance the next reason pass can apply.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Long-pressing a completed episode squeezes out a distilled lesson token that docks to the LongTerm shelf.
touch_interaction.visual: A droplet of insight condenses from the episode tile and slides onto a lesson shelf, glowing when later reused.

examples.mini_scenario: A verified fix yields the lesson 'validate path before write', which docks to LongTerm and surfaces on the next file task.
examples.pitfall: Distill only from verified outcomes; a lesson drawn from an unverified success encodes a false rule the agent will repeat.

examples.title: Refresh the WorkingContext at the start of a turn
examples.intent: Reset the immediate context to the current conversation, task, and active code.
examples.how_it_shapes_the_loop: WorkingContext (messages, current_task, active_code) is refreshed each turn so the foundation layer always assembles the LlmContext around the true present state.

touch_interaction.canvas_action: Double-tapping the working node clears its stale slots and repopulates them with the current turn's state.
touch_interaction.visual: The working node blinks, old slots dim out, and fresh message/task/code slots fill in with a clean-slate shimmer.

examples.mini_scenario: At a new turn the user double-taps working; last turn's active_code clears and the file now under edit populates it.
examples.pitfall: Stale active_code in WorkingContext misleads reasoning; failing to refresh it makes the agent reason about a file it already moved past.
